title: Channel-led partnerships and pilot clusters should lead entry because they pair **high strategic fit** with **easier execution**

blocks.title: Channel-led partnerships sit in the priority zone
blocks.body: Position: **high strategic fit**, **easier execution**. Uses the existing distributor base, input-led farmer access, and field activation model.

blocks.title: Pilot clusters convert early demand into repeatable delivery
blocks.body: Position: **high strategic fit**, **easier execution**. Concentrates demand, operator supply, training, and proof points in a tight geography.

blocks.title: Company-owned fleet build-out is harder to execute at entry
blocks.body: Position: **high strategic fit**, **harder execution**. Requires upfront fleet, operations control, maintenance processes, and local capacity before demand is proven.

blocks.title: Standalone digital marketplace models should follow, not lead
blocks.body: Position: **low strategic fit**, **harder execution**. Relies less on the core channel and advisory strengths while needing rapid two-sided network build.
